title: Tipton's Major Curry Affair Named Restaurant of the Year at BCA Awards
excerpt: Major Curry Affair in Dudley Port, Tipton, took the West Midlands Restaurant of the Year title at the 19th Bangladesh Caterers Association Awards in London on November 1, beating three other regional finalists.
body:
• Major Curry Affair, in Dudley Port, Tipton, has been named Restaurant of the Year for the West Midlands at the 19th Bangladesh Caterers Association (BCA) Awards 2026.
  • The ceremony was held on Sunday, November 1 at the Park Plaza Westminster Bridge Hotel in London; the restaurant won from a shortlist of four West Midlands establishments.
  • Judges assessed food quality, service, hospitality, presentation, consistency, innovation and overall customer experience.
  • If you go: the restaurant is at Unit 3, Ashfield House, Fisher Street, Dudley Port, Tipton DY4 8XE, serves Indian, Asian, Balti and Bangladeshi dishes, and is unlicensed — diners can bring their own drinks.

A restaurant in Dudley Port has been named Restaurant of the Year at a national awards ceremony celebrating the British Bangladeshi hospitality industry. Major Curry Affair, based in Dudley Port, Tipton, received the regional title at the 19th Bangladesh Caterers Association (BCA) Awards 2026, Birmingham Now reported. The restaurant's own announcement put it plainly: "WE DID IT!!! WE WON RESTAURANT OF THE YEAR 2026."

The award

The ceremony took place on Sunday, November 1, at the Park Plaza Westminster Bridge Hotel in London. Major Curry Affair was selected from a shortlist of four establishments across the West Midlands; the other finalists were Entouraj in Cutnall Green, Droitwich Spa, Kolkata Lounge in Bournville, Birmingham, and Shazanz in Lozells, Birmingham. Restaurants were assessed by a judging panel on food quality, service, hospitality, presentation, consistency, innovation and overall customer experience. The restaurant credited the hard work of Tarik, its award-winning chef Koyes and their team.

"Congratulations to Major Curry Affair on a thoroughly deserved win. Their achievement reflects the talent, commitment and resilience that continue to drive British Bangladeshi hospitality forward."

— Oli Khan MBE, president, Bangladesh Caterers Association

The ceremony was attended by political figures including Bangladesh's High Commissioner to the UK, Mohammed Abdul Muhith, and MPs Seema Malhotra, Kevin Bonavia, Rupa Huq, Sir James Cleverly and Daniel Zeichner. BCA secretary general Tipu Rahman said the 19th awards recognised the achievements of members and aimed to inspire the next generation of hospitality professionals and entrepreneurs.

The industry behind it

The Bangladesh Caterers Association represents approximately 12,000 curry houses and takeaways across the UK. According to the association, the sector supports around 100,000 jobs and generates approximately £4.2 billion in turnover. The annual awards recognise the contribution of Bangladeshi restaurants and catering businesses to the UK's hospitality sector — the businesses that built the British curry house as an institution.

Visiting Major Curry Affair

Major Curry Affair is at Unit 3, Ashfield House, Fisher Street, Dudley Port, Tipton DY4 8XE, on the corner of Dudley Port and Fisher Street. Its menu spans Indian, Asian, Balti and Bangladeshi cooking. The restaurant is unlicensed, and its listing notes that diners are welcome to bring their own alcoholic drinks, with soft drinks available — a detail worth knowing before you go, and one that keeps a meal there moderately priced.
